summary: OptiScreen integrations backend tested end-to-end: Push (register + test + daily-pick + earnings-reminder), ElevenLabs TTS/STT, PayPal sandbox config/create-order/capture-order, plus regression on /api/auth/login and /api/screener/best-options. 22/22 pytest cases pass. Push endpoints handle the EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY=placeholder scenario gracefully (never crash): /push/test, /push/daily-pick, /push/earnings-reminder all return 200 with {ok:false,error:'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid'} as documented in the playbook. ElevenLabs TTS returns a valid data:audio/mpeg;base64 blob (b64 length ~29KB); STT correctly transcribes a generated WAV. PayPal sandbox token exchange works; create-order returns an approve_url on https://www.sandbox.paypal.com with correct plan prices (simple=9.00, advance=29.00, expert=79.00); invalid plan -> 400; bogus capture -> 502. Auth gating verified on every protected endpoint. No MongoDB _id leaks observed in any response.
action_items: No action required. Confirm the deployer swaps EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY=placeholder with a real key at build time; preview env correctly surfaces the 401 as {ok:false,error:'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid'} without raising.

Optional hardening: /api/register-push currently bubbles upstream 401 as HTTP 500 via HTTPException(500,'EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY missing or invalid') (integrations.py:33). This is per playbook, but main agent may want to also return {ok:false,error:...} like /push/test for symmetry when the device-registration call happens on an unauthenticated public endpoint.

Optional: integrations.py:17 instantiates a module-level httpx.AsyncClient with X-Push-Key header baked in. If EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is rotated at runtime, this client won't pick it up — tolerable since .env is read once per process start.
critical_code_review_comments: integrations.py:17-21 — module-level httpx.AsyncClient is created at import time; header is pinned. Fine for deploy-time key injection, but means tests cannot monkeypatch EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY after import.
integrations.py:33 — register_push_token raises HTTP 500 on upstream 401; /push/* routes in server.py catch Exception and translate to {ok:false,error}. Consistent with playbook.
integrations.py:81 — ElevenLabs client is None if key missing; TTS/STT then raise 500 'ElevenLabs not configured'. Current key works; verified.
server.py:629-632 — /stt/transcribe reads whole upload into memory then passes to ElevenLabs; fine for short clips but set a size cap for production.
integrations.py:174-175 — PayPal return/cancel URLs are hardcoded to the preview domain. Should be derived from EXPO_BACKEND_URL or a dedicated PAYPAL_RETURN_URL env var for environment portability.
server.py:665 — paypal_capture returns {status, plan, order_id} but drops the raw object; good for client safety.
seed_data_creation: Reused seeded trader@optiscreen.app / TestPass123! from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. No new persistent users created. One PayPal sandbox order was created per create-order test (3 total) — these are sandbox-only and expire automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Integration test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_integrations.py. BASE_URL and seed_token fixtures are in conftest.py. Push tests assume EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY=placeholder (preview env) — do NOT fail on upstream 401, verify graceful {ok:false,error} shape. ElevenLabs calls take ~3-7s; PayPal token calls ~1-3s; both are well under 30s timeouts. All 22 cases passed in ~10s with 2-worker parallel scheduling.
rca_of_issue: No new bugs. Prior iteration_1 ObjectId bug remains fixed. The 'push test returns ok:false' is NOT a bug — it is expected graceful degradation for a placeholder key, as called out in the request's agent_to_agent_context_note.
